args.sql: SELECT invoice, txn_type, trans_date, ROUND(amount,2) AS amount, ROUND(settled,2) AS settled, closed FROM erp_cust_trans WHERE account='US-021' ORDER BY trans_date
SELECT s.payment_id, s.invoice_id, ROUND(s.amount,2) AS applied, s.settle_date FROM erp_settlements s WHERE s.account='US-021'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount-settled),2) AS open_now FROM erp_cust_trans WHERE account='US-021' AND txn_type='Invoice' AND closed=0
